claims: Jon Scheyer is the head coach of the Duke University men's basketball team.
Jon Scheyer has held the position of head coach of the Duke University men's basketball team since the 2022-23 season.
Jon Scheyer succeeded Mike Krzyzewski as head coach of the Duke University men's basketball team.
Jon Scheyer is a former Duke player.
Jon Scheyer has led the Blue Devils to 89 wins in his first three seasons.
The Blue Devils had an Elite Eight appearance in 2024.
